text_en: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，作于飘流在犹大旷野时。

text_en: O God, you are my God, I seek you, my soul thirsts for you; my flesh faints for you, as in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
text_cn: 天主，你是我的天主，我急切寻觅你； 我的灵魂渴慕你，我的肉身切望你， 我有如一块干旱涸(hé)竭(jié)的无水田地。

text_en: So I have looked upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and glory.
text_cn: 昔日我曾在圣殿里瞻仰过你， 为看到你的威能，和你的光辉；

text_en: Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you.
text_cn: 因你的慈爱比命更宝贵， 我的唇舌要时常称颂你。

text_en: So I will bless you as long as I live; I will lift up my hands and call on your name.
text_cn: 我要一生一世赞美你， 我要因你名把手举起！

text_en: My soul is satisfied as with a rich feast, and my mouth praises you with joyful lips
text_cn: 我的灵魂好似饱享了膏脂， 我要以欢愉的口唇赞美你。

text_en: when I think of you on my bed, and meditate on you in the watches of the night;
text_cn: 当我在我床上想起了你时， 我便彻夜不寐地默想着你。

text_en: for you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I sing for joy.
text_cn: 因为你曾作了我的助佑， 我要在你的羽翼下欢舞。

text_en: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.
text_cn: 我的灵魂紧紧追随你， 你的右手常常扶持我。

text_en: But those who seek to destroy my life shall go down into the depths of the earth;
text_cn: 那些谋图陷害我命的人， 必将堕落在地下的深层；

text_en: they shall be given over to the power of the sword, they shall be prey for jackals.
text_cn: 他们必为刀剑所杀死， 也必然为野犬所分食。

text_en: But the king shall rejoice in God; all who swear by him shall exult, for the mouths of liars will be stopped.
text_cn: 但是君王必要因天主而喜庆； 凡以天主宣誓的人，必要自幸， 因为说谎的口，必要喑（yīn）哑失声。
